title: NodeGX — what's new
description: Release notes shown in the NodeGX editor. An empty items list means there is nothing to announce; the editor treats that as a normal state and opens no modal.

items.title: NodeGX 0.4.3
items.content_html:
NodeGX 0.4.3

The backend on your computer can make smaller copies of photos. A photo on an app's cards and lists showed as a broken image on 0.4.2.

Saving an app sends its cloud functions only to its own backend. In 0.4.2 a save sent them to every backend running on your computer.

Everything in 0.4.3
